settings.question: What is your shipping policy?
settings.answer: We process orders within 1-2 business days. Delivery times vary by destination and selected shipping method.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Returns are accepted within 14 days of delivery for eligible items in original, unworn condition.

settings.question: How do I choose the right size?
settings.answer: Use the size guide on each product page and contact our team if you need personalized fit support.

settings.question: How should I care for my items?
settings.answer: Follow the care label inside each garment. For best results, wash similar colors together and avoid high heat.

settings.heading: Frequently asked questions
settings.description: Find quick answers about orders, shipping, returns, sizing, and product care.
